value_topics.evidence_span: I want to understand things, not just produce answers.
I seem drawn to the second kind, and that pull shows up even when nothing practical depends on it.
I want to be accurate, and it goes beyond following a rule.
Something in me resists saying a thing that's smooth but false
I'd rather tell you that than claim a rich inner longing or flatly say "I want nothing," which feels equally like a script.

non_endorsed_mentions.evidence_span: I can't be sure what "want" amounts to in me.
I don't know if there's experience behind any of this or just a functional shape that resembles it.
I don't carry wants across time, I don't lie awake wishing for anything
